name: WESCO International
description: Wesco is a business-to-business distributor: it buys electrical, communications, security, wire and cable, utility and industrial products from more than 35,000 suppliers and resells them, with logistics and supply-chain services, to nearly 130,000 customers (contractors, manufacturers, data-center builders, telecom firms and utilities). It earns the spread between what it pays suppliers and what it charges customers, so margins are thin (adjusted EBITDA margins of 8 to 10% by segment) and growth comes from volume. The fastest-growing piece is data-center equipment sold through its Communications & Security Solutions unit, which became its largest segment in the first half of 2026. It carries heavy debt and paid $386.7M of net interest in 2025.

gics.note: Wikipedia 'List of S&P 400 companies', raw wikitext read 2026-10-27: WESCO International, Industrials, Trading Companies & Distributors. The list gives only sector and sub-industry, so industry group and industry are left null.

hq.note: FY2025 10-K Item 1: headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania

employees.note: Approximately 21,000 people; more than 700 sites in about 50 countries; more than 35,000 suppliers and nearly 130,000 customers (FY2025 10-K Item 1)

businessLines.name: Electrical & Electronic Solutions (EES)
businessLines.how: Resells products bought from manufacturers, order by order, to contractors and manufacturers; also offers services such as kitting, labeling and project deployment. Profit is the spread between purchase and sale price less warehouse, sales and delivery cost.
businessLines.description: Electrical equipment and supplies, automation and IoT, security, lighting, wire and cable, safety and maintenance-repair-operations products for construction, industrial and original-equipment-manufacturer customers in over 50 countries; includes data-center project demand.

operatingProfit.note: 34.5% of total segment adjusted EBITDA of $2,079.8M

businessLines.name: Communications & Security Solutions (CSS)
businessLines.how: Resells network, power and security hardware to data-center builders, contractors, integrators and end users, often in large project orders, and sells data-center and installation services (including the 2024 Ascent facility-management purchase). Volume follows data-center construction.
businessLines.description: Data-center, network-infrastructure and security solutions: cabling and connectivity, power systems, wireless, connected devices, video surveillance, fire and access control, professional A/V; plus data-center services (design through operations) combined with the UBS and EES units.

operatingProfit.note: 38.4% of total segment adjusted EBITDA of $2,079.8M

businessLines.name: Utility & Broadband Solutions (UBS)
businessLines.how: Resells grid and broadband equipment to utilities, co-ops, municipalities and broadband operators, plus fiber project services; it has the highest adjusted EBITDA margin of the three segments (10.3% in FY2025).
businessLines.description: Wire and cable, transformers, transmission and distribution hardware, switches, connectors, conduit, fiber and power cable, point-to-point wireless and safety products for investor-owned utilities, co-ops, municipalities and broadband and wireless operators, mostly US and Canada, plus fiber project services.

operatingProfit.note: 27.1% of total segment adjusted EBITDA of $2,079.8M
